intro.text: A Thaylen sailor and medic aboard the Wandersail.

items.text: Fimkn sailed with the expedition to Akinah and became friends with Lopen on the way. When Lopen pulled Turlm out of the sea, Fimkn checked on him and sent him below, as another sailor had already taken his place. During the fight against the Sleepless on Akinah, Fimkn bound the wounds of an injured man.
